question: Which of the following is the State Bird of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Great Indian Bustard**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan's state bird **is **the Great Indian Bustard.**
 
• It's a huge bird with long naked legs and a horizontal body.
 
• This species, which has an ostrich-like look, is the heaviest of the flying birds.
 
• Hunting and the degradation of its habitat, which comprises huge swaths of dry grassland and scrub, have made the species severely endangered. It is protected by India's **Wildlife Protection Act of 1972**.
 
• It, however, received no attention and remained BPL (Below Protection Line).​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Asian koel **is the state bird of Jharkhand.
 
• Uttar Pradesh's state bird is the** Sarus Crane**.
 
• **The Indian roller** is the state bird of Odisha, Telangana, and Karnataka in India.
